known_issues: Upload system does not allow uploading .mp3 files (needs debugging/fix).

existing_features.title: Update the audio file selection validation so that .mp3 files can be selected and accepted even when the browser reports an empty/unknown MIME type (e.g., file.type is ""), while still rejecting clearly non-audio files.

Make metadata extraction for uploads robust for MP3s: if Web Audio API `decodeAudioData` fails for an MP3, fall back to an alternate duration detection strategy (e.g., HTMLAudioElement metadata loading). If duration still cannot be determined automatically, allow the user to manually enter/edit the track duration in the upload UI and proceed with upload.

new_feature_requests.summary: Verify and, if needed, adjust the backend/blob-storage integration so that storing and serving uploaded MP3 blobs works correctly (including correct handling of audio/mpeg content type where applicable) and does not reject MP3 uploads.

projectName: Fix MP3 uploads in the audio upload system
